verdicts.reason: A breaks the product art: the can floats away from its circle, and the body copy sits on top of the circle, jammed against the left edge, which is a clear text-on-graphic collision. The GLACIER wordmark also drops below the headline, and the badges are oversized, so they compete with the CTA. B keeps the can inside its circle and the headline and CTA group reads cleanly. But B has a large dead area on the left, and the body copy is split off to the far right edge, after the product, so the reading order is wrong. The badges in B are too large, and 'BACK BYDEMAND' is missing a space.
